shell.nav.label: Main
shell.chat.title: Help chat is coming soon
shell.chat.body: Soon you can ask things here, like which department fixes streetlights or when your ticket is due. For now, you can report an issue in three steps and follow it in My issues.
shell.report.title: Report an issue
shell.report.description: Three steps: your pincode, a pin on the map, then a photo and a few details.
shell.issues.title: My issues
shell.issues.description: Every issue you report shows here with its ticket ID and status.
shell.issues.emptyHint: Spot a pothole, broken light or garbage pile? Report it in three steps.
shell.community.title: Community
shell.community.description: Notices from neighbours in your pincode about what was reported and what changed.
shell.community.emptyHint: Share an update about an issue you reported, so neighbours know what is being fixed.
shell.notFound.title: Page not found
shell.notFound.emptyHint: The link may be old or have a typo. Check the address, or go back to the home page.
